batting.name: JC Buttler
batting.dismissal: c MM Sharma b HH Pandya

batting.name: SV Samson
batting.dismissal: c HH Pandya b J Little

batting.name: Shubman Gill
batting.dismissal: st SV Samson b YS Chahal

balls.text: brilliance from Abhinav Manohar in the field with a direct hit from the boundary! Slower length ball angled across seventh stump produces a miscued heave swirling high over extra cover. It looks like it could be a chance but the fielder running back from the edge of the ring can't get there as it lands just out of his reach. However, Manohar was charging in from the sweeper boundary and collects off one bounce, firing in a sharp one-bounce throw that skids into the striker's end stumps to deny Zampa coming back for a second run. He's out by two yards.
full on middle and leg, flicked to deep midwicket for one.
good length ball on the legs at 135 kph, flicked through midwicket for one.
length ball on fourth stump at 136 kph, tries to swat this over midwicket and a thick edge flies behind point for one.
back of a length on off, guided through point for one.
back of a length on off, defended to cover for none.
yorker on middle and leg at 139 kph, jammed out back to Shami.
bouncer over middle stump, wide called as it sails over Sandeep without needing to duck.
good length ball on off stump at 139 kph, prodded defensively to cover for none.
bullseye! 142 kph yorker with a radar locked in on the base of off stump. Boult was backing away trying to drive through cover and is beaten with off stump ripped out of the ground.
good length ball on fourth stump at 141 kph, tapped through cover for one.
good length ball on off, flicked through midwicket for one.
good length ball on fifth stump, guided behind point for one.
back of a length on seventh stump, goes to cut and misses.
full on fifth stump, goes for another big drive but misses.
full on middle, Boult winds up and unleashes a heave over midwicket that carries just beyond the LCD ad screens. It lands 73 meters back and finally the home crowd has something to cheer about.
zings this flat and very wide outside off, left alone and wide called.
good length ball on fifth stump, slapped to the cover sweeper for one.
good length ball spins sharply down the leg side, wide called.
full and wide, goes to drive and misses.
full and wide, chipped in the air wide of Rashid to long-off for one.

dropped! Fullish length on fifth stump, Boult flicks this loosely back toward Rashid and he reaches out above his head across his body but it slips off his right ringers past the umpire for one to mid-off.
good length googly on fourth stump spinning in and is flicked to short fine leg for none.
Boult shuffles across to scoop over fine leg and misses a googly that spins sharply down leg for a wide.
good length ball pushed down the ground for one.
good length ball on off, defended.

full on off, stock legbreak spins in and Hetmyer defends down the wrong line hit on the pads below the knee. Big lbw shout upheld. Royals are out of reviews. He was hit in front of off. Possible it might have skidded to miss off based on the angle but more likely that it would have wound up as umpire's call on ball-tracking. That's irrelevant now though. Hetmyer is gone and Royals are eight down.
good length ball on fifth stump, goes back to flick through midwicket for one.
full and sprayed way down the leg side almost off the pitch. Diving stop by the keeper saves five.
full on middle, flicked along the ground past the bowler to long-on for one.
good length ball flicked down the ground for one.
good length ball on fifth stump, pokes this behind point for one.
full on eighth stump, Boult drives at this and a thick edge goes wide of slip to the third man rope.

flighted full and on the borderline of leg stump, Jurel prods forward down the wrong line and is hit on the pads stretching forward, big lbw shout upheld. He doesn't hesitate to review this.  He's banking on this pitching outside the line of the stumps because otherwise this was stone dead. It pitches well in line with the stumps, more closer to middle and leg and ball-tracking is showing this ripping out middle halfway up. Rajasthan have lost both reviews.
good length ball on sixth stump, guided to deep third for one.
good length ball on fifth stump at 142 kph, guided to backward point for one, needless throw at the non-striker's stumps results in an overthrow to turn this into two.
bouncer on off stump, ducked under by Jurel.
good length ball on the stumps, flicked through the ring for one.

dropped at slip! Good length ball angled across fifth stump, Jurel shuffles across and pokes at this as a thick edge flies to Tewatia's right at slip. He puts in a diving effort stretching to his right at hip height for this but the one-handed chance bursts through and goes to deep third for one.
good length ball on fourth stump at 143 kph, defended to backward point.
full and wide, driven to extra cover for none.
good length ball slanted across sixth stump, cuts this to the sweeper for one.
Jurel shows he's not going to allow that field to stay for long, breaks out the reverse sweep first ball to a good length ball on off and middles this past short third to the rope.

bullseye! Almost a mirror reflection of Rashid's wicket of Ashwin. That was a right-armer bowling a right-hander. Here Noor the left-armer bowls the left-handed bat Padikkal prodding inside the line of a delivery that just skids on after pitching on fourth stump to rip out the top of off stump.
back of a length on fifth stump, punched to long-off for one.
full on sixth stump, miscues a drive back to Noor.
back of a length on off stump at 143 kph, guided to deep third for one.
full on middle at 143 kph, driven to long-on for one.
full on fourth stump at 141 kph, smokes a drive flat to mid-off for none.
good length ball on fifth stump at 143 kph, punched wide of mid-off for one.
good length ball on fourth stump at 140 kph, punched through to extra cover for none.
back of a length on fifth stump, sliced to deep third for one.
full on off, blocked again on the front foot.
googly angled in on fifth stump before spinning away, Hetmyer stretches forward to smother this and a thick edge bounces short of slip.
googly lands short and wide on seventh stump, slapped to the cover sweeper for one.
good length ball sliding down the leg side for a wide.
good length ball on middle, goes back deep in his crease to flick through midwicket for one.

googly spins in sharply from fifth stump and hits Parag in front of middle and off. Deflection goes to slip for a catch as the appeal goes up for lbw and is upheld. Parag looks forlornly at his partner before opting for DRS more so in desperate hope than belief.  A frankly terrible review borne out of a plea to justify the move to use him as an impact sub. The ball misses bat and hits him on the back leg just above the knee roll, but flexing some way, in front of middle stump and is going on to smash middle 3/4 of the way up.
full on the stumps and flicked through wide long-on for two.
back of a length on fourth stump at 143 kph, flicked into midwicket for one.
back of a length on fifth stump, punched to extra cover for none.
back of a length on off stump at 140 kph, guided to deep third for one.
back of a length on middle, tapped into midwicket for one.
back of a length on fifth stump at 140 kph, tapped into cover for none.
back of a length on fourth stump, sliced behind point for one.

bullseye! Rashid was toying with Ashwin throughout that over. Good length ball on fourth stump just skids on flat past an attempted flick by Ashwin through midwicket. He was playing for a googly but this one just came on flat rather than turn in sharply and it goes past the outside edge to smash over off stump.
fuller and a touch wider on sixth stump, this time Ashwin misses a drive.
good length legbreak on fifth stump, Ashwin goes back to punch and is beaten.
good length ball on the legs, flicked through midwicket for one.
full on fifth stump, flicked along the ground to long-on for one.
back of a length googly on seventh stump, slices this to backward point for none.
full and wide, sliced to the point sweeper for one.

fullish length on middle and off at 141 kph, shuffles across his stumps to flick this over midwicket but it climbs on him and results in a top edge swirling over cover. Hardik shuffles forward five yards from the edge of the ring and pouches this reaching forward at waist height.
good length ball on the stumps, tapped away into midwicket for one.
143 kph delivery full on fourth stump, elegant punch by Padikkal sizzles through wide mid-off to the rope. Just a gentle punch with a high elbow finish.
full on middle, whipped to wide long-on for one.
in the slot on fourth stump at 141 kph, Samson winds up and powers a drive flat through wide mid-off to the rope.
full and quick on off, punched to long-on for one.
good length on fourth stump, pushed wide of mid-off for one.
good length outside leg, flicked to short fine leg for none.
googly on a good length on fourth stump spins to middle and is punched to mid-on for one.
googly on middle spins into leg, flicked to square leg for none.

chaos and a runout! Short and wide, Samson tries to guide this past backward point but a spectacular diving stop is made by the backward point fielder Abhinav who deflects this directly to the fielder Mohit at short third just a few meters away. Jaiswal set off for a single from the non-striker's end and there looked likely to be a clear single judging by the fact that Jaiswal reached the striker's end standing alongside Samson by the time Mohit let go of a calm throw to Rashid over the non-striker's stumps. He collects and slams the ball into the stumps to end Jaiswal's stay. Samson took three strides down the pitch after contact, but then was guilty of ball-watching and Jaiswal was left sold out. Jaiswal tried to scamper back and wound up running 40 yards in the end winding up four yards short of making the ground again at the non-striker's end.
length ball on fourth stump, opens the face to guide this for one to deep third.
142 kph back of a length on off stump, miscues a punch off the back foot that dribbles into midwicket for none.
143 kph back of a length on fifth stump, punched through cover for two.
short and wide, goes to repeat the shot but bottom edges this into the ground to backward point for none.
short and wide, slashed wide of deep third for two.
length ball on fifth stump at 145 kph, slices this in the gap between backward point and short third to the rope.
back of a length on the legs, flicked through the leg side for one.
140 kph back of a length on the legs, flicked behind square leg for one.
length ball on fifth stump at 138 kph, goes to cut and is beaten.
full outside leg following him backing away, flicked through square leg for one.
length ball at 127 kph on off, sits up for Samson to pull this off the front foot over wide midwicket sailing 95 meters back landing in the 12th row.
short on off at 140 kph, pulled firmly through square leg to the rope.
short on sixth stump, opens the face to guide this wide of deep third for two.
full on the legs, whipped away along the turf through wide midwicket and skips away to the rope.
back of a length on the hips again at 147 kph, this time late trying to flick this away and dribbles off the pads for none.
over the roof at fine leg!  Length ball on the thigh, just swivels to flick this high over the VIP stand tent on that side of the ground landing 84 meters back.
132 kph delivery back of a length on off, goes back to tap and run short of mid-on for one.
fullish length on fifth stump at 143 kph, punched to extra cover for none.
bouncer on seventh stump, Jaiswal tries to uppercut this over the slips but can't make contact.
fullish length ball on the stumps, tapped short of mid-on for a tight single.

slashes this straight to short third! Deep square leg was pushed out after the previous two boundaries and short third is brought into the ring from deep third and it pays off immediately. Length ball on seventh stump at 136 kph, looks like a pretty innocuous delivery that Buttler chases flat-footed and a thick edge flies straight to the fielder on the ring, Mohit, who snaps this up on his left thigh.
142 kph delivery aimed full on the legs, flicked along the ground through backward square leg to the rope.
good length ball on the hips at 139 kph, just a gently flick and it flies off the bat along the ground through midwicket to the rope.
Jaiswal charges forward to this 137 kph delivery landing back of a length swinging into the hips, misses a flick and comes off the pads into cover for a leg bye.
137 kph delivery lands back of a length swinging away from fifth stump, Buttler fishes at it and there's some more movement after it passes the edge but the ball doesn't carry to the keeper.
back of a length on sixth stump, tapped into the covers for one.
144 kph delivery lands back of a length on sixth stump, left alone.
back of a length at 134 kph tailing past the hips, wide called.
short and wide at 141 kph, Jaiswal stays in his crease this time and cuts a bottom edge dribbling behind point for one to get off the mark.
back of a length on fifth stump, Jaiswal charges again trying to cross bat smash this over mid-off but misses again.
back of a length angled across fourth stump, Jaiswal charges forward first ball to drive and is beaten.
and Saha pushes it to long-off! Full and slow on the stumps, and a gentle nudge to wrap up a massive win. GT win by nine wickets, and with 37 balls to spare
drives this full ball on middle to long-off to keep ticking
full on middle and leg, and slog swept to fine leg
swats this shortish ball outside off to long-off
pulled to deep midwicket, as the ball is short on middle, and turns away
good length outside off, and slapped to deep point
turns in off a good length to finish on middle. Clipped to midwicket
full on leg with a curving action, and chipped to long-on
swatted to deep point! Boult from deep extra cover dived to his left, but couldn't stop that. Pandya saw the ball short and wide of off, and slammed that hard
length ball just outside off, and guided wide of short third
good length on middle and leg. Pushed to deep midwicket
short again outside off, and now pumped to deep point's right
very slow, and on a length. And four to deep backward point, as he hacks that very late. Sandeep from deep point can do little, as it's timed and placed beautifully
short outside off, and slapped to deep backward point. Two more, as Sandeep dives to cut that off to his left
shortish on off, and punched towards point
good bounce, and some turn away. Good length on off, and goes away, as Pandya is surprised by the bounce while trying to push. Beaten there
short, wide of off, and quite slow. Turns away, as it is flashed to deep extra cover
very full on the stumps, and pushed to deep midwicket. The over costs 24
just a single, and a relief to my fingers. Short around off, and slapped to deep point
six more! Pandya is stone-faced, and why not? Stands outside leg, and deep in the crease, before clubbing this length ball around middle and leg back down the pitch
Remember Pandya vs Zampa from the ODI series in 2017? Pandya is giving us a flashback. Sees another loopy and full delivery on the stumps, and goes launching into it over the bowler's head
hacked hard to deep extra cover! Short and wide of off, and a rap hard with a flat bat
belted back 90 degrees! Zampa tossed it up, and went full on the stumps. Pandya stood with his front leg out of the way, and sent that flying back
good length outside leg, and nudged towards deep midwicket
full on the stumps, and pushed to short cover

stumped by Samson! Chahal has a few words to utter out. Now he slows it down to Gill too - like he has done to Saha today - and completely foxes Gill. It was a legspinner, pitched on a length on middle stump. Gill saw that tossed up and danced down the pitch, little realising that it was much slower than the previous balls. He missed, the ball turned well away, and Samson found him short
full on the stumps, and flatter. Driven to long-off
much slower, and with some loop. Full outside off, and turning further away, as Saha misses his slog sweep
short around off, and slashed to deep point
good length on the stumps. Goes deep and clips to deep square for a hurried two
low full toss just outside off. Gets an inside edge on to his pad as he tries to flick
keeps low off a shortish length on middle and off. Chopped towards cover
wow, that looked so elegant! Just a gentle drive to this full and loopy ball on off, and places it wide of long-off
short and quicker on middle. Punched back to the bowler
very full, and a bit wide of off. Driven to deep point
short again, and turning away towards off. A swipe between long-on and deep midwicket, as the former fielder slides to cut that off
now the googly. Short outside off, and turning in. Slashed to point, where the fielder dives to his right and lets it dribble towards deep point
misses his sweep, as this length ball outside off is much slower while turning away
much fuller on the stumps, and pushed to long-on
turns away towards off from a good length on middle. Dabbed down to Chahal's right
full on off, and driven to cover
short again outside off. Hints to turn away, and is hacked to deep point
lands between short fine chasing to his left, and fine leg rushing forward. Saha tried to sweep this length ball turning in, but ended up ballooning
very full and on the stumps. Driven to long-on
short on off, and slapped to deep backward point. I am sure even Gill must have had no clue that it would end up as four, considering it was only placed nicely
now turns away off a good length, and ends around off. Pushed back to the bowler
turns in and keeps low right away to end on middle. Flicked to deep midwicket after getting across
backs away, and ends up fending this good length ball finishing outside leg after angling in to cover
swiped to deep midwicket! The fielder at midwicket dived to his right, but in vain. Short ball on middle, which angles in, but Gill makes room to swing that for four
length ball on the stumps, as he backs away but ends up pushing it to Sandeep's left
good length ball just outside off, and finds cover with his punch
sliced over mid-off! He sat deep in the crease, and got a length ball outside off. He just lofted with an open face of the bat
half-flicks this full delivery around off to mid-on. And it's a no-ball
length ball on leg, driven to short cover, who fumbles to allow a single
good length on off, and clipped to deep square
smacked between cover-point and extra cover! Too short and too wide outside off from Boult, and Saha gets on top of it to cut hard
chipped over mid-on! That looked effortless, even as Boult bowled at only 116kph. Lofts that with his back leg in the air, as the full ball arrived on the stumps
good length on off, and clipped with a flat bat towards midwicket
fuller, and wider of off. Driven to mid-off
lofted over mid-on! A stylish shot, as the length ball angles across to end outside off. He holds the pose too, while swinging across the line
drilled wide of mid-off! Jumps out of the crease after making room, and converts the ball into a low full toss on the stumps. Presents the full face of the bat to send that whistling away
quite full on off, and flicked to short midwicket

appeal for leg before wicket by Sandeep, but not given. Sandeep and Samson get together, and RR review. Ah, replays show it was a knuckle ball. On a good length on middle and leg, slides down the leg side. Saha tries to swipe but is beaten, while being hit on his left thigh. No bat involved, and the impact was outside leg. So RR lose a review
stands outside leg, and skips down a bit to nudge this good length ball on middle and leg to long-on
slower ball on a good length on off. Saha taps it close to the pitch on the off side, and takes off
good length on off, and punched to mid-off with a sweet sound off the bat
guides this good length ball on off to the point fielder, as he opens the bat face late
fuller side of a length on off, and pushed towards midwicket
good length on middle and off, and nudged towards mid-on, as the bat turns in his hands
trickles for four to deep point! Boult goes short, and angles it across, as the ball ends slightly wide of off. Gill rides the bounce, and slaps it to deep point
now finds the man at cover with his drive, as this length ball arrives at fifth stump
the cover fielder dives to his left to save a few potential runs. Short of a length outside off, and punched back by Gill
gets off the mark off the sixth ball. A little clip off the length ball on the stumps, and a single to deep square
punches this shortish ball, shaping away to end just outside off. Finds the cover fielder
there is a man somewhere between short mid-on and short midwicket, and Gill finds him with his flick off this full ball angling into the stumps
length delivery in the channel outside off, and tucked back
short of a length, angling in late to finish on off. No room for Gill to nudge with a flat bat towards cover
good length ball, sliding into his pads. Clipped to short fine
full just outside off, but finishes on off stump. Tucked to cover
inside edge past the stumps! Saha going for everything here. Much fuller ball just outside off, as he seemed to have driven early at that. Single to fine leg
hacked just past point! The point fielder leaped to his right, but the ball was way above him. Short and wide from Boult, and Saha slashed hard
driven between mid-off and cover! Just uses the pace, and the ball races away though the quick outfield. Fullish ball and a bit wide of off, as he presents the full face of the bat
length ball on fifth stump, as Saha pushes at it but back to the bowler off the inside half of the bat
shorter side of a length, cramping him for room as it angles in from middle stump. Hits Saha high on the glove in front his chest, with the ball dribbling towards the man at backward short leg
